symbols.name: Packer instruction-skip NOP
symbols.detail: Undocumented $3C NOP consumes bytes that also encode LDA #$FF when entered at the following address (single instruction site).

symbols.name: Copied TOWER1 loader
symbols.detail: Sets drive 8, secondary address 8 and filename TOWER1, then calls $FFD5; entry point.

symbols.name: Packed stub entry
symbols.detail: Machine-code entry reached by SYS2088; the loader later jumps back here to run the second unpacker; entry point.

symbols.name: Picture joystick fire check
symbols.detail: Calls $6855 and compares the masked joystick bits; joystick fire leaves the release picture.

symbols.name: Trainer relocation XOR copy
symbols.detail: XORs six pages with $08 while copying $6927–$6F26 to $C900–$CEFF, then jumps to $CAD9.

symbols.name: Game entry
symbols.detail: Game entry reached from the second unpacker after TOWER1 loads (LDA #$01, JMP $8017).

symbols.name: Menu call
symbols.detail: Menu call that leaves return address $804B on the live stack (single instruction site).

symbols.name: First-tower loop
symbols.detail: First-tower game loop used as the logic boundary; entry point.

symbols.name: Menu routine
symbols.detail: Original menu routine whose entry marks the title as waiting to start; entry point.

symbols.name: Vertical routine
symbols.detail: Vertical routine selected by Up at the next doorway/lift through mutable call operands; entry point.

symbols.name: Joystick reader
symbols.detail: Writes the CIA port, reads both ports and derives the direction/fire fields at $24–$26; entry point.

symbols.name: Clear-screen CHROUT call
symbols.detail: JSR $FFD2 with the clear control, serviced by the existing screen-clear implementation.

symbols.name: Intro Space wait
symbols.detail: Calls GETIN and loops until it returns Space ($20) to leave the release intro.

symbols.name: Sound driver
symbols.detail: Start of the original sound driver; entry point.

symbols.name: Jump-sound driver branch
symbols.detail: Sound-driver branch reached when fire follows walking (the jump sound).

symbols.name: KERNAL CHROUT
symbols.detail: KERNAL character output; the observed clear control enters the screen-clear service; entry point.

symbols.name: KERNAL LOAD
symbols.detail: KERNAL LOAD called by the copied loader and resolved by the shared disk LOAD service; entry point.
